trigger: Plays immediately when starting Episode 0 in Qublox HQ penthouse.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Neo-Amritsar, 2084. 11:58 PM. Final Cut delivery is in nine hours.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Oyeee pagaalllll! Who triggered a full recompile on the production branch?!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Relax, Ashwath. I have delegated your panic to third-party consultants.

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: WHO TOUCHED MY ANAMORPHIC LENS?! WHY IS THE VIEWFINDER TURNING BEIGE?!

lines.speaker: beige
lines.text: Greetings creatives. Your aesthetic unpredictability has been deprecated.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: The render drive! BEIGE just suctioned the Final Cut through the AC vent!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Unacceptable. Stealing our master file violates three vendor agreements.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Sayam, grab your wallet. We're breaking through the security grid!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Le re! Time to expense some corporate property damage.
